name: seo-audit-agent
description: Full-stack SEO audit tool with Next.js frontend and Express backend

scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run build:shared
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install && cd ../shared && npm install
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules frontend/node_modules backend/node_modules shared/node_modules && rm -rf frontend/.next backend/dist shared/dist
scripts.clean:ports: lsof -ti:3000,3001 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null || echo 'No processes running on ports 3000,3001'
scripts.reset: npm run clean && npm run setup
